content_en: SEPARATE PEDESTRIAN ACCESS: The gate opener is intended for installation only on gates used for vehicles. Pedestrians should use a separate entrance to avoid contact with the moving vehicular gate.

content_en: ENTRAPMENT ZONES ASSESSMENT: Identify all entrapment zones specific to your installation type. These zones are areas around the automatic gate system where a person or object could be caught that increase the risk of injury. Verify that entrapment areas are clear of potential obstructions before installing the gate opener.

embedding_text: Before Installation: ENTRAPMENT ZONES ASSESSMENT. Identify and clear entrapment zones specific to installation type to prevent injury.

content_zh: 平开门准备：不要将轮子安装在门上。确保门垂直、水平，并且在铰链上自由摆动，不会束缚或拖拽地面。门应安装在非常稳固的柱子或立柱上，这些柱子或立柱应用水泥固定在地面上。如果柱子的宽度或直径小于 15 厘米（6 英寸），则应为金属或用水泥固定。这确保了稳定性并最大限度地减少了门运动引起的扭曲效应。
content_en: SWING GATE PREPARATION: Do not attach wheels to the gate. Ensure that the gate is plumb, level, and swings freely on its hinges without binding or dragging on the ground. The gate should be mounted to a very stable post or column that is secured in the ground with concrete. If the post's width or diameter is under 15cm (6"), it should be either metal or set in cement. This ensures stability and minimizes the twisting effect caused by gate movement.

section.chapter_title: Terminal Function of the Control Board

content_zh: 控制板端子功能对照表：①+24、③GND 端子输出24VDC电压为光电传感器供电；②PHOTO、③GND 接收光电传感器信号，常闭(NC)输入；④O/S/C、⑤COM 通过常开干接点信号控制大门循环开/停/关/停，常接推杆开关、有线密码器、外接收器；⑥OPSW、⑤COM 接收车辆检测器常开输出的开门信号；⑦EDGE、⑧GND 接收防夹边缘传感器常开信号；⑨⑩+LOCK- 输出接大门电锁正负极，要求失电闭锁型、额定24VDC、额定电流<3A；⑪⑫+BAT- 输入接24VDC电池或电源正负极，为整个系统供电；⑬⑭ADAPTER 输入接适配器为电池充电，也可接36VDC或24VAC电源；⑮⑯+LAMP- 输出接警示灯正负极，要求额定24VDC、额定电流<1A；⑰⑱+MOTOR- 接机械臂电机红黑线；⑲DLMT、⑳COM、㉑ULMT 接限位开关，近端限位接DLMT和COM，远端限位接ULMT和COM。
content_en: Terminal Function table: (1)+24 (3)GND - Provide 24VDC to power photocell sensors. (2)PHOTO (3)GND - Receive photocell NC signal. (4)O/S/C (5)COM - Open/stop/close/stop cycling via NO dry contact. (6)OPSW (5)COM - Vehicle sensor NO opening signal. (7)EDGE (8)GND - Edge sensor NO. (9)(10)+LOCK- - Electric lock fail-secure 24VDC <3A. (11)(12)+BAT- - 24VDC battery/power input. (13)(14)ADAPTER - Adapter charging; 36VDC or 24VAC. (15)(16)+LAMP- - Warning light 24VDC <1A. (17)(18)+MOTOR- - Motor red/black wires. (19)DLMT (20)COM (21)ULMT - Limit switches; near-end DLMT/COM, far-end ULMT/COM.

section.chapter_title: Connect the Arm to the Control Board

content_zh:
1. 将线束穿过电缆接头插入控制箱。
2. 将红色电线连接到端子 ⑰ “+MOTOR1”，将黑色电线连接到端子 ⑱ “MOTOR1-”，将蓝色电线连接到端子 ⑲ “DLMT”，将绿色电线连接到端子 ⑳ “COM”，将黄色电线连接到端子 ㉑ “ULMT”。
3. 拧紧每个螺钉，以防电线松动脱落。
content_en:
1. Insert the wire harness through the cable gland into the control box.
2. Connect the red wire into terminal ⑰ “+MOTOR1”, the black wire into terminal ⑱ “MOTOR1-”, the blue wire into terminal ⑲ “DLMT”, the green wire into terminal ⑳ “COM”, and the yellow wire into terminal ㉑ “ULMT”.
3. Tighten each of the screws so that the wires do not come loose and fall out.

content_zh: 接线必须由专业电工完成，以避免受伤、触电或死亡的风险。在所有安装完成之前，切勿将开门器连接到电源插座。建议使用额定电流为 5A 的浪涌保护器与 TS24-U 适配器或电源（单独出售）。如果电源插座位于室外，请使用防风雨盖进行保护。
content_en: A professional electrician is required for wire connection to avoid the risk of injury, electric shock, or death. NEVER connect the gate opener to the electrical outlet before all the installations have been done. It is recommended to use a surge protector with a rated current of 5A with the TS24-U adapter or power supply (sold separately). Protect the electrical outlet with a weatherproof cover if it is located outdoors.

content_en: Connect the TS24-U adapter to the "ADAPTER" terminals of the control board, regardless of the polarity of the wires. Connect two 12VDC batteries in series to achieve 24VDC (batteries not included). Connect the batteries to the "+BAT-" terminals of the control board. Plug the TS24-U adapter into an electrical outlet.

content_zh: 适配器仅用于给电池充电。适配器输出电缆的长度为 1.2m (4ft.)。为了延长电缆，电缆应至少为 2C x 1.3 mm² (16AWG)。如果控制板与适配器之间的距离超过 100m (330ft.)，电缆应至少为 2C x 2 mm² (14AWG)。最大延长距离为 300m (1000ft.)。如果开门器由电池供电并利用交流电充电，则需要至少一个 24VDC 7Ah 汽车/船用型电池。
content_en: The adapter is ONLY used to charge the battery. The length of the adapter output cable is 1.2m (4ft.). To extend the cable, the cable should be at least 2C x 1.3 mm² (16AWG). If the distance between the control board and the adapter is more than 100m (330ft.), the cable should be at least 2C x 2 mm² (14AWG). The maximum extension distance is 300m (1000ft.). If the gate opener is powered by batteries and utilizes AC electricity for charging, a minimum of a 24VDC 7Ah automotive / marine type battery is required.

section.step_title: Power Mode 3 By the Adapter, Solar Panels and Batteries

content_zh:
通过适配器、太阳能电池板和电池连接。
1. 将TCS3太阳能充电控制器的BAT线连接到控制板的“+BAT-”端子。
2. 缠绕TCS3太阳能控制器的LOAD线，以防止短路。
3. 串联连接两个12VDC电池，以获得24VDC电源（不包括电池）。
4. 将电池连接到控制板的“+BAT-”端子。
5. 组装太阳能电池板，并将太阳能电池板并联连接，安装在没有障碍物和遮挡物（如建筑物和树木）的区域。如果位于赤道以北，太阳能电池板应朝南；如果位于赤道以南，则应朝北。
6. 将TCS3太阳能控制器的SOLAR线连接到太阳能电池板。
7. 将TS24-U适配器连接到控制板的“ADAPTER”端子，不考虑线的极性。
8. 将TS24-U适配器插入电源插座。
content_en:
Power Mode 3 By the Adapter, Solar Panels and Batteries
1. Connect the BAT wires of the TCS3 solar charge controller to the “+BAT-” terminals of the control board.
2. Tape the LOAD wires of the TCS3 solar controller to prevent a short circuit.
3. Connect two 12VDC batteries in series to achieve 24VDC (batteries not included).
4. Connect the batteries to the “+BAT-” terminals of the control board.
5. Assemble the solar panels and connect the solar panels in parallel and mount in an area clear of all obstructions and shading from buildings and trees. The solar panel should face south if it is located north of the equator. If it is located south of the equator, it should face north.
6. Connect the SOLAR wires of the TCS3 solar controller to the solar panels.
7. Connect the TS24-U adapter to the "ADAPTER" terminals of the control board, regardless of the polarity of the wires.
8. Plug the TS24-U adapter into an electrical outlet.

content_zh:
重要注意事项
1. 电池应防水，或放置在防水外壳中。
2. 适配器仅用于给电池充电。适配器输出电缆的长度为1.2米（4英尺）。为了延长电缆，电缆应至少为2C x 1.3 mm²（16AWG）。如果控制板与适配器之间的距离超过100米（330英尺），电缆应至少为2C x 2 mm²（14AWG）。最大延长距离为300米（1000英尺）。
3. TCS3太阳能充电控制器支持最大240W的太阳能电池板功率，超过此限制可能会损坏设备。

content_en:
IMPORTANT NOTES
1. The batteries should be waterproof, or they should be placed in waterproof housing.
2. The adapter is ONLY used to charge the battery. The length of the adapter output cable is 1.2m (4ft.). To extend the cable, the cable should be at least 2C x 1.3 mm² (16AWG). If the distance between the control board and the adapter is more than 100m (330ft.), the cable should be at least 2C x 2 mm² (14AWG). The maximum extension distance is 300m (1000ft.).
3. The TCS3 solar charge controller supports a maximum solar panel power of 240W, exceeding this limit can cause damage to it.
4. If the gate opener is powered by batteries and utilizes both AC electricity and solar panel for charging, a minimum of a 24VDC 7Ah automotive / marine type battery and a 24V 20W solar panel are required.

section.step_title: For Pull-to-Open Installation: Adjust the Limit Switch B to Determine the Closed Position

content_zh:
确保在调整限位开关之前，当门处于完全打开位置时，移动杆完全缩回。
通电操作开门器，臂杆将伸出以关闭门。
如果门关闭超过所需的关闭位置，请按遥控器停止开门器。使用螺丝刀松开限位开关B的螺丝，稍微向内滑动限位开关B。
如果门关闭到一半而未能达到所需的关闭位置，请稍微向外滑动限位开关B。
请重复上述步骤，直到门到达并自动停止在所需的关闭位置。然后拧紧螺丝。
content_en:
Make sure that the moving rod is fully retracted when the gate is in the fully open position before adjusting the limit switch.
Turn on power to operate the gate opener, the arm will extend to close the gate.
If the gate closes over the desired closed position, press the remote control to stop the gate opener. Use a screwdriver to loosen the screw of the limit B, slightly slide the limit switch B inwards.
If the gate closes halfway and fails to get to the desired closed position, slightly slide the limit switch B outwards.
Please repeat the above steps until the gate reaches and automatically stops at the desired closed position. Then tighten the screw firmly.

content_zh:
电位器
FORCE 电位器：调整开门机的失速力
顺时针转动电位器可增加力，逆时针转动可减小力。
失速力调节门在操作过程中对障碍物的敏感性。较高的失速力会降低敏感性，使门更不容易检测到物体。较低的失速力会增加敏感性，导致门在遇到即使是轻微的障碍物时也会停止或反转。
AUTO CLOSE 电位器：调整开门机的自动关门时间
顺时针转动电位器可增加自动关门时间，逆时针转动可减小自动关门时间。自动关门时间可在 3 到 120 秒之间调整。
SOFT STOP 电位器：调整开门机的软停止周期
顺时针转动电位器可增加软停止周期，逆时针转动可减小软停止周期。软停止周期可在 1 到 5 秒之间调整。
软停止旨在门完全停止前的最后阶段减慢门速，从而保护电机。
在进行调整之前，请关闭开门机的电源。调整后，打开电源并使用遥控器运行完整的开门和关门循环以校准完整的开门和关门时间。这将确保调整在随后的循环中有效。

Potentiometers
FORCE Potentiometer: Adjust the Stall Force of the Gate Opener
Turn the potentiometer clockwise to increase the force, and counterclockwise to decrease it.
Stall force regulates the gate's sensitivity to obstacles during operation. A higher stall force decreases sensitivity, making the gate less likely to detect objects. A lower stall force increases sensitivity, causing the gate to stop or reverse when encountering even minor obstructions.
AUTO CLOSE Potentiometer: Adjust the Auto Close Time of the Gate Opener
Turn the potentiometer clockwise to increase the auto close time, and counterclockwise to decrease it. The auto close time can be adjusted from 3 to 120 seconds.
SOFT STOP Potentiometer: Adjust the Soft Stop Period of the Gate Opener
Turn the potentiometer clockwise to increase the soft stop period, and counterclockwise to decrease it. The soft stop period can be adjusted from 1 to 5 seconds.
The soft stop is designed to slow down the gate during the final phase before it fully stops, protecting the motor.
Turn off the power to the gate opener before making adjustment. After adjusting, turn on the power and use the remote control to run a complete open and close cycle to calibrate the full open and close times. This will ensure the adjustment is effective in subsequent cycles.

Key Installation Notes
• Mount the photocell sensor at least 20cm (8") above the ground.

• Ensure that both the emitter and receiver are aligned with each other. If manual precise alignment is difficult, use a visible laser beam for assistance.
• The maximum sensing range is 20m (65ft.), and the recommended distance between the emitter and receiver is 3m to 14m (10ft. to 46ft.).
• Put the cables into PVC conduit and bury the conduit underground to prevent damage.

content_zh:
检查门：检查门和铰链是否有任何损坏、生锈或磨损迹象。
检查开门机臂：检查开门机臂是否牢固地连接到门和立柱支架。拧紧任何松动的螺栓和螺钉。
检查电缆和电线：确保所有电缆和电线完好无损，没有任何割伤或磨损。
电池维护：定期检查电池是否漏液，并确保其外壳完好无损。通过控制板监控电池电压。每2-3年更换电池，并妥善回收旧电池。
content_en:
Inspect the Gate: Check for any signs of damage, rust, or wear on the gate and hinges.
Check Gate Opener Arm: Check that the arm is securely attached to both the gate and post brackets. Tighten any loose bolts and screws.
Examine Cables and Wires: Ensure that all cables and wires are intact, without any cuts or frays.
Battery Maintenance: Regularly check for battery leakage and ensure that its casing is intact. Monitor the battery voltage through the control board. Replace the battery every 2-3 years and recycle old batteries properly.
embedding_text: Maintenance Routine Inspections: Inspect gate, check gate opener arm, examine cables and wires, battery maintenance.

content_zh:
使用干净的干布擦拭开门机轴，然后喷洒硅酮喷雾以减少摩擦。
在温度降至1°C（30°F）或以下的寒冷气候中，每4-6周对开门机臂喷洒硅酮喷雾以防止结冰。确保硅酮喷雾的冰点低于当地最低温度。
content_en:
Using a clean, dry cloth to wipe the gate opener shaft, and then apply a silicone spray to reduce its friction.
In cold climates where temperatures drop to 1° C (30° F) or below, apply silicone spray to the gate opener arm every 4-6 weeks to prevent freezing. Ensure the silicone freezing point is lower than the lowest local temperature.
embedding_text: Maintenance Cleaning and Lubrication: Wipe gate opener shaft, apply silicone spray, cold climates, prevent freezing.

content_zh: 当遇到固体障碍物时，门在关闭时必须反转，在打开时必须停止。如果已调整失速力，请参考本手册中的“失速力调整和障碍物测试”部分，重新测试开门器。未能正确调整和重新测试开门器可能会增加受伤或死亡的风险。

This guide provides common trouble shooting steps to help resolve issues efficiently. For further assistance, please feel free to contact us through our website at www.topens.com.

content_zh:
症状：开门机不运行，电源指示灯不亮。

content_en:
Symptom: The opener does not run / Power LED does not ON.

content_zh:
症状：开门机不运行，电源指示灯不亮。

content_en:
Symptom: The opener does not run / Power LED does not ON.
Step 2 Verify Power Supply: Confirm that the TS24-U adapter is plugged into an AC main socket or that the batteries (two 12V batteries connected in series) are properly connected to the TCS3 solar charge controller.
embedding_text: Troubleshooting: Opener does not run, Power LED OFF. Symptom: The opener does not run, Power LED does not ON. Step 2: Verify Power Supply. Check TS24-U adapter to AC main socket or batteries to TCS3 solar charge controller.

content_zh:

content_en:
Symptom: The opener does not run / Power LED does not ON.
Step 3 Check Battery Voltage: If only battery is used to power the gate opener, ensure it is not over-discharged. The voltage should be above 22V for normal operation. Allow the battery to charge until it reaches above 22VDC.
embedding_text: Troubleshooting: Opener does not run, Power LED OFF. Symptom: The opener does not run, Power LED does not ON. Step 3: Check Battery Voltage. Ensure battery voltage is above 22VDC, charge if needed.

section.step_title: Inspect TCS3 Solar Charge Controller Output

content_zh:
症状：开门机不运行，电源指示灯不亮。
解决步骤4：检查TCS3太阳能充电控制器输出。如果使用太阳能电池板和TCS3太阳能充电控制器为电池充电，请测量TCS3太阳能充电控制器的输出电压。如果电池电压高于22VDC，但控制器输出电压低于21VDC，则太阳能充电控制器可能存在故障。

Symptom: The opener does not run / Power LED does not ON.
Step 4 Inspect TCS3 Solar Charge Controller Output: If solar panels and the TCS3 solar charge controller are used to charge batteries, measure the output voltage of the TCS3 solar charge controller. If it is below 21VDC while the battery voltage is above 22VDC, the solar charge controller may be defective.

section.step_title: Gate automatically opens, but does not automatically close - Check DIP Switch Setting

content_zh: 症状：门机自动打开，但不会自动关闭。可能解决方案：检查DIP开关设置：DIP开关#1的设置可能不正确。控制板上的DIP开关#1用于选择门机的操作模式（推/拉打开）。如果门向物业内部打开（拉开），将DIP开关设置为OFF（出厂默认设置）。如果门向物业外部打开（推开），将DIP开关设置为ON。
content_en: Symptom: Gate automatically opens, but does not automatically close. Possible Solution(s): Check DIP Switch Setting: The setting of DIP switch #1 may be incorrect. DIP Switch #1 on the control board is used to select the gate's operation mode (push/pull to open). If the gate opens into the property (pull to open), set the DIP Switch to OFF (factory default setting). If the gate opens out from the property (push to open), set the DIP Switch to ON.

section.step_title: Adjust the Position and Direction of the Antenna

content_zh: 症状：遥控距离小于20m（65英尺）。可能解决方案：步骤1 调整天线的位置和方向：打开控制箱，找到控制板顶部的黑色天线。调整天线的位置和方向（垂直、水平或倾斜）以优化信号接收。使用遥控器测试门机操作，检查遥控距离是否改善。如果距离仍然不足，请继续执行步骤2。
content_en: Symptom: Remote control range less than 20m (65ft.). Possible Solution(s): Step 1 Adjust the Position and Direction of the Antenna: Open the control box and locate the black antenna on the top of the control board. Adjust the position and direction (vertical, horizontal or tilted) of the antenna to optimize signal reception. Test the gate operation with the remote control to check if the control range has improved. If the range remains insufficient, proceed to Step 2.

content_en: Symptom: Remote control range less than 20m (65ft.). Possible Solution(s): Step 2 Pull the Antenna Out from the Control Box: Pull the antenna through the cable gland at the bottom of the control box and extend it fully straight for optimal signal reception. Test the gate operation with the remote control to check if the control range has increased. If the range is still insufficient, proceed to Step 3.

section.step_title: The opener does not run, Power LED flash rapidly - Check Battery Voltage

content_zh: 症状：门机不运行。电源LED快速闪烁（LED以200毫秒/秒的速度亮起，正常情况下LED以500毫秒/秒的速度亮起）。可能解决方案：检查电池电压：电池可能过度放电。检查电池电压以确保其高于22V，这是门机正常运行所必需的。
content_en: Symptom: The opener does not run. Power LED flash rapidly (the LED is ON 200ms per second, normally the LED ON 500ms per second). Possible Solution(s): Check Battery Voltage: The battery may be over-discharged. Check the battery voltage to ensure it is above 22V, as this is necessary for the gate opener to function properly.

content_en: This page provides troubleshooting steps and solutions for different symptom scenarios for A3S, A5S, A8S industrial gate openers.

section.step_title: Check DIP Switch Setting (Symptom: Gate opens randomly)

content_zh: 检查DIP开关设置：控制板上的DIP开关#1用于选择门机的操作模式（推开/拉开）。如果门向物业内部打开（拉开），将DIP开关设置为OFF（出厂默认设置）。如果门向物业外部打开（推开），将DIP开关设置为ON。
content_en: Step 1 Check DIP Switch Setting: DIP Switch #1 on the control board is used to select the gate's operation mode (push/pull to open). If the gate opens into the property (pull to open), set the DIP Switch to OFF (factory default setting). If the gate opens out from the property (push to open), set the DIP Switch to ON.

section.step_title: Isolate the Issue with Wired Accessories (Symptom: Gate opens randomly)

content_zh: 隔离有线附件的问题：从控制板上断开所有有线附件。关闭DIP开关#3以禁用光电传感器功能。再次尝试操作门机。如果问题消失，则问题可能出在某个附件上。逐一连接每个附件，以确定是哪个附件导致的问题。如果断开所有附件后问题仍然存在，请继续执行步骤3。
content_en: Step 2 Isolate the Issue with Wired Accessories: Disconnect all wired accessories from the control board. Turn off DIP Switch #3 to disable the photocell sensor function. Try operating the gate again. If the problem disappears, the issue might be with one of the accessories. Connect each accessory one by one to identify which one causes the problem. If the issue is still present after disconnecting all accessories, proceed to Step 3.

section.step_title: Reprogram Remote Controls (Symptom: Gate opens randomly)

content_zh: 重新编程遥控器：首先从控制板上删除所有现有的遥控器代码，然后重新编程遥控器。操作门机，查看随机打开问题是否已解决。
content_en: Step 3 Reprogram Remote Controls: First remove all existing remote codes from the control board and then reprogram the remote controls. Operate the gate to see if the random opening issue has been resolved.

content_en: Step 4 Replace the Control Board: If none of the above steps resolve the issue, the control board may be faulty. Replace the control board with a new one.

section.step_title: Turn Off the Power to the Gate Opener and Restart It (Symptom: Soft stop function is abnormal)

content_zh: 关闭门机电源并重新启动：如果您曾使用释放键手动打开门或重置软停时间，请关闭门机电源并重新启动。然后，使用遥控器执行完整的打开和关闭循环，以校准完全打开和关闭时间。
content_en: Step 1 Turn Off the Power to the Gate Opener and Restart It: If you have used the release key to manually open the gate or reset the soft stop time, turn off the power to the gate opener and restart it. Then, use the remote control to run a complete open and close cycle to calibrate the full open and close times.

content_zh: 检查限位开关：检查限位开关是否正常工作并能停止门。

section.step_title: Check If the Soft Stop Functions Correctly (Symptom: Soft stop function is abnormal)

content_zh: 检查软停功能是否正常：在门机未安装在门上时测试软停功能。如果功能正常，请确保门是水平的，在铰链上自由摆动，并且门机不受门打开和关闭惯性或任何门弹簧力的影响。
content_en: Step 3 Check If the Soft Stop Functions Correctly: Test the soft stop function when it is not mounted on the gate. If it functions properly, ensure the gate is level, swings freely on its hinges, and that the gate opener is not affected by the inertia of gate opening and closing or by any gate spring force.

section.step_title: Adjust Stall Force (Symptom: Gate moves a little and then reverse or stop)

content_zh: 调整失速力：失速力设置可能过低。关闭门机电源，然后找到控制板上的FORCE电位器，并将其稍微顺时针旋转以增加失速力。调整后，使用遥控器打开和关闭门，检查问题是否解决。
content_en: Step 1 Adjust Stall Force: The stall force setting might be too low. Turn off the power to the gate opener, then locate FORCE Potentiometer on the control board and turn it slightly clockwise to increase the stall force. After adjusting, use the remote to open and close the gate to check if the issue is resolved.

section.step_title: Check for Free Swinging (Symptom: Gate moves a little and then reverse or stop)

content_zh: 检查自由摆动：将门与门机断开，并确保门能自由摆动，没有任何卡滞。
content_en: Step 2 Check for Free Swinging: Disconnect the gate from the gate opener and ensure the gate swings freely without any binding.
